replay: Each 8-state window has seven complete 20 ms transitions from a single training episode. Draw two thirds uniformly and one third beginning at a finger contact when available.
initial_dataset: The 16 registered training P6 held, release and transient-open episodes from the 24-episode full dataset.
interaction_dataset: Union of those episodes and available separately identified training mixed-teacher and common-parent student episodes. Validation and test cases are excluded.
validation: Up to 768 equally spaced legal validation windows per horizon H1, H7 and H32, reported including noncontact, single finger and simultaneous contact cases.

actor_comparison.camera_bridge_training: Compact 6x6 RGB-D features to common parent 48-dimensional visual activations, with one target per unique physical exposure from the same training episodes. Frozen during policy updates.

representative_pilot.episode: tr_nominal_pull_15_held in the independent pilot directory
representative_pilot.backend: NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell Server Edition, PyTorch 2.14.0+cu130
representative_pilot.final_head: two finger peak-existence probabilities and the fraction of simultaneous above-threshold contacts across the ten physical substeps
